node.role: Versioned LLM prompts for classifier, grouper, and writer agents. Prompt hash changes auto-invalidate the AI cache.

node.name: Changelog Output
node.role: Index changelog and versioned per-release files produced by the pipeline.

node.name: M-CONTEXT
node.role: Per-app execution context (ChangelogCtx). Derives all paths from KernelRuntimeContext + env vars + flags.

node.name: M-TYPES
node.role: Zod schemas: RawCommit, ClassifiedCommit, GroupedRelease.

node.name: M-SANIT
node.role: Prompt injection guard. Applied to all commit text fields before AI.

node.name: M-LIMIT
node.role: p-limit(5) wrapper. Prevents AI API rate limit errors.

node.name: M-SCHED
node.role: Release window detection. Weekly/monthly modes with correct short-month clamping.

node.name: M-GIT
node.role: Git log extraction via simple-git. Produces RawCommit array scoped to app directory.

node.name: M-ATOMIC
node.role: Atomic file write: tmp+rename. Used by M-INDEX.

node.name: M-CACHE
node.role: SQLite WAL + file-based fallback cache with composite key. Resilient to cherry-pick and squash merge.

node.name: M-CLASS
node.role: AI classifier. Deterministic rules + LLM fallback. Outputs ClassifiedCommit with confidence.

node.name: M-GROUP
node.role: AI grouper. Clusters ClassifiedCommits into GroupedRelease.

node.name: M-WRITE
node.role: AI writer. Generates human-readable Markdown sections per group.

node.name: M-BUMPER
node.role: Confidence-gated SemVer bumper. Major locked. Low-confidence breaking changes produce requiresReview.

node.name: M-INDEX
node.role: Rebuilds CHANGELOG.md index. Writes versioned files atomically. Restores missing dynamic markers.

node.name: M-MAIN
node.role: OS command handlers (runChangelogGenerate, runChangelogRebuildIndex, runChangelogBackfill). Orchestrates the full pipeline.

node.name: packages/surface
node.role: RFC-0192 Programmatic Surface route-source port: framework-free Blueprint contract/assembly + axis-generic eligibility engine. `BlueprintLevel` includes optional `pillar` field (RFC-0490) for depth-0 hub specialization with hero, adaptation, productPrice, and finalCta sub-blocks, and optional `dossier` field (RFC-0492) for depth-1 industry dossier configuration (gate thresholds, claim restrictions, doorway/duplicate thresholds). Pure functions only — all I/O lives in kernel commands.

node.name: Semantic layer
node.role: Full semantic layer: `SemanticPageType` (includes `"collection"` for CollectionPage + ItemList JSON-LD, RFC-0490), `SemanticPageModel` (includes optional `collectionItems`, `surfaceId`/`depth` for depth-gated JSON-LD corrections, `industryService` for industry-specific Service node, RFC-0492), JSON-LD builders (`buildServiceNodes` suppresses org-level Service nodes for depth-1 `website-local` pages), llms projections, page builders.

node.name: Ontology blueprints
node.role: Blueprint YAML specs for Programmatic Surface generation. `website-local.yaml` depth-0 level includes `pillar` block and `semanticType: collection` (RFC-0490); depth-1 level includes `dossier` block with gate thresholds, claim restrictions, and doorway/duplicate thresholds (RFC-0492).

node.name: surface.hub.validate
node.role: RFC-0490: validates depth-0 pillar hub configuration — hero CTA anchoring, title template, published industries, commercial promise phrases, priceRef syntax. Diagnostics: pillar-hero-cta-not-anchor, pillar-commercial-promise, pillar-missing-title-template, pillar-orphan-industry (warn), pillar-no-published-industries, pillar-priceref-unresolvable.

node.name: RFC-0490 Industry Navigation Hub
node.role: Repositions the website-local depth-0 pillar as an industry navigation hub. Adds `pillar` block to `BlueprintLevel`, `"collection"` to `SemanticPageType`, `CollectionPage` + `ItemList` JSON-LD, and `surface.hub.validate` command. Amends RFC-0238 and RFC-0207.

node.name: surface.industry.validate
node.role: RFC-0492: validates depth-1 industry dossier records against the publication gate (minimum field counts), claim policy (prohibited result-claim phrases), and deprecated field usage. Reads `dossier.gate` and `dossier.claimRestrictions` from the blueprint's depth-1 level. Diagnostics: industry-gate-below-threshold, industry-claim-restriction, industry-deprecated-field, industry-missing-new-field.

node.name: surface.doorway-risk.report
node.role: RFC-0492: reports depth-4 city pages missing local context fields (localDemandContext, uniqueIntro, uniqueFaq, localEvidence). Diagnostic — emits warnings, blocks surface.validate when flagged share exceeds `dossier.doorwayMaxFlaggedShare` threshold. Diagnostics: doorway-risk-missing-local-context.

node.name: surface.duplicate-content.report
node.role: RFC-0492: reports depth-1 industry page pairs with high prose similarity (shingle-based Jaccard). Blocks surface.validate when any pair exceeds `dossier.duplicateMaxSimilarity` threshold (default 0.70). Diagnostics: duplicate-content-pair.

node.name: RFC-0492 Industry Dossier Model
node.role: Adds `dossier` block to `BlueprintLevel` for depth-1 industry dossier configuration (gate thresholds, claim restrictions, doorway/duplicate thresholds). Adds `IndustryDossierFields` interface, `surfaceId`/`depth` on `SemanticPageModel`, industry-specific Service JSON-LD node, three new commands (`surface.industry.validate`, `surface.doorway-risk.report`, `surface.duplicate-content.report`), and `migrator-0492`. Declares `breaksC: true` for Service JSON-LD type addition.

node.name: ratgeber.provenance.validate
node.role: RFC-0502: validates ratgeber editorial provenance — author IDs resolve to author records, source IDs resolve to source descriptors, claim IDs exist in claim record collection (RFC-0505: updated from sidecars to surface/claims/), source IDs appear in Quellen section. Diagnostics: RG-PROV-01..06.

node.name: ratgeber.claim.validate
node.role: RFC-0505: validates ratgeber claim records at surface/claims/{lang}/*.md — schema, claimId uniqueness, articleId resolution, source binding for factual/regulatory claims, calculationInputs for calculation claims, URL validity, expiry warnings, disputed status warnings, PBP value drift warnings. Diagnostics: RG-CLAIM-01..09.

node.name: RFC-0502 Ratgeber Editorial Provenance
node.role: Adds author records (`surface/authors/{lang}/`), article source bindings (`sources` frontmatter field), claim sidecar scanning for articles, provenance footer in `bakeRatgeberArticle`, and `ratgeber.provenance.validate` command. Amends RFC-0500.

node.name: ratgeber.policy.validate
node.role: RFC-0503: validates ratgeber editorial policy page existence, required H2 sections, review cadence (reviewedAt > 3 months warning), published article required fields, and no review-required article in surface artifact. Diagnostics: RG-POL-01..05.

node.name: RFC-0503 Ratgeber Editorial Policy Page and Status Workflow
node.role: Adds editorial policy page (prose + page entries), ratgeber.policy.validate command, hub link to policy page, url-schema extension for /ratgeber/redaktion/, and article status workflow (review-required exclusion from surface). Amends RFC-0500.

node.name: RFC-0504 Ratgeber Article 12-Section Layout
node.role: Adds article-header (Himalia), toc (Metis), changelog (Prometheus) block types to archetype registry. Rewrites bakeRatgeberArticle for 12-section layout with article-header, TOC, sectioned markdown, changelog, three-tier CTA. Adds RG-ART-07..10 validation rules. Adds rfc-0504 migrator (articleSections/changelog fields + H1 stripping). Amends RFC-0500 and RFC-0501.

node.name: RFC-0505 Ratgeber Extended Claim Registry
node.role: Adds structured claim record collection (surface/claims/{lang}/*.md) with claimId, articleId, claimText, claimType, sourceRefs, calculationInputs, limitations, verifiedAt, expiresAt, reviewStatus. Adds rfc-0505 migrator (transform claim sidecars to claim records, delete sidecars). Amends RFC-0502.

node.name: RFC-0506 Ratgeber Article JSON-LD — Article Fields, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage Prohibition
node.role: Updates ratgeber depth-1 Article JSON-LD: adds description and mainEntityOfPage to Article optional fields in C-contract, prohibits FAQPage on ratgeber depth-1, extends SemanticPageModel with authorRecord/reviewedAt/changelog, updates buildArticleNode for structured Person author and URL-string mainEntityOfPage, suppresses FAQPage in buildFaqNodes.
